Name: ramibow's Emily Redesign
Author: ramibow
Description:
[center][size=5][b]🌈 ramibow's Emily Redesign
[/b][/size][/center][center]───────────────────────── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ─────────────────────────[/center]
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]This is a redesign of Emily's portraits and sprites in my art style. I wanted to give her a more stylish look that stays true to her character. I also decided to make her features more distinct since all the bachelorettes have similar face shapes. Color palette is mostly taken from her vanilla sprite, so it shouldn't stand out too much from the NPCs.

Enjoy! ♡

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][u]NOTE[/u]: [/font][i][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/font][/i]

[/font]
